target.title: refactor(zalouser): share offset-preserving text chunk ranges
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Zalouser maintained a private copy of offset-aware text range splitting even though outbound text and Markdown chunking belong to the shared `plugin-sdk/text-chunking` surface. That duplicated paragraph/newline/whitespace policy and made native Zalo style offsets harder to keep aligned with shared chunking behavior.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds `chunkTextRanges` to markdown-core, exports it through `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-chunking`, and migrates Zalouser while keeping only its native style slicing locally. The helper preserves every input code unit and separator, prefers paragraph/newline/whitespace boundaries when requested, and keeps surrogate pairs intact. Matrix HTML rendering and QQBot's stateful table/fence repair are intentionally unchanged because they remain channel-specific.

## User Impact

No intended change to Zalouser's rendered long-text, table, fenced-code, whitespace, or native-style output. Supplementary Unicode characters can no longer be split into invalid standalone chunks at an exact hard boundary.

## Evidence

- Before implementation: `pnpm test extensions/zalouser/src/send.test.ts` passed 17/17 tests with exact fence, table, whitespace, long-text, and style fixtures on Testbox `tbx_01kxcgntcfv6w0w9p5gd7pcxmw`.
- Exact rebased head: focused SDK + Zalouser tests passed 52/52 assertions on Testbox `tbx_01kxcjt5t2pyqre1cf6wn06vxm`, Actions run https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29218309014.
- `pnpm check:changed`, `pnpm plugin-sdk:surface:check`, `pnpm check:docs`, and `pnpm build` passed on the patch; the conflict-free rebase was followed by exact-head SDK surface/API-baseline checks.
- Source-blind built-API behavior contract passed hard, preferred, table, fence, repeated-whitespace, empty, fallback, and surrogate-boundary probes.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output` completed clean after the accepted Unicode-boundary finding was fixed and retested.

AI-assisted: Codex implemented and reviewed this maintainer-requested cleanup.
